notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Western Navajo Fair in Tuba City, April L. Fowles, 928-283-5544, and handwritten dates Oct. 16-19. Current official Western Navajo Fair information shows Oct. 8-11, 2026, so preserve the handwritten dates as source history but use the official site as the current date reference. Source: handwritten call notes, page 87; current official fair website.
